note: mécanisme du contrat de services Google (Ask Media Group) : Google partage avec la société une part du prix payé par les annonceurs ; revenu reconnu brut, la part versée aux distributeurs tiers étant comptée en coûts d'acquisition de trafic ; contrat expiré le 30 avril 2026 ; aucun montant dans ce bloc
quote: Paid listings are priced on a price-per-click basis and when a user submits a search query through an Ask Media Group business and then clicks on a Google paid listing displayed in response to the query, Google bills the advertiser that purchased the paid listing and shares a portion of the fee charged to the advertiser with the Ask Media Group business. The Company recognizes paid listing revenue from Google when it delivers the user's click.
